name: Amadeus Musical Theater and Art Day Camp
description_short: Three week musical theater, music and art day camp in Chappaqua for ages 5 to 14, 9:30 to 2:30. Campers rehearse a show, take a private lesson on their instrument or voice, write songs, play in bands and paint the sets, ending with a staged performance in a theater.
refund_policy_summary: Payment in full at registration and due by June 10; cancellations carry a $150 processing fee and later cancellations lose part or all of the fee; no refunds after the first day except for a documented medical emergency.
notes: Three weeks for $1,775. The registration page prints a one week price twice, as $1,195 and as $1,175, and also lists a 6 week option at $2,675 although the camp runs three weeks. Cards carry a 3.9% charge. Families pack a bag lunch and two snacks and arrange their own travel.
